summary: Iter64 public share-link feature: 17/17 backend tests PASS (auth create, idempotent reuse, team_access gate, public data for signup/roster/sizes, public submit auto-apply flows, HTML page render with brand+script, invalid-token 404 HTML, DELETE revocation deactivates link and both public endpoints then return 404). Browser tests PASS: signup public page renders slots, guest can submit name+qty and claim appears on the page; sizes public page renders member dropdown + 8 size inputs, submit succeeds and shows 'Thanks!' message. In-app frontend PASS: signup-share / roster-share / sizes-share testIDs all present; opening the signup sheet detail after a public guest claim correctly DISPLAYS the guest_name ('TEST_BrowserGuest') and NOT 'Unknown'. All TEST_ data cleaned; applereview team_access still true.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding rate-limiting to /api/public/share/{token}/submit — currently anyone with a leaked token can flood the sheet with claims / create roster members / overwrite sizes.
Roster public submit upserts by normalized name — two distinct people with the same name would merge silently. Fine for MVP but worth documenting.
shareTeamLink util catches errors and shows Alert; on web Share.share is a no-op which is by design per the review request.
seed_data_creation: None — all test data (signup sheet, slot, guest claim, roster member, size value, and 3 share links) was created and fully cleaned up after tests. team_access confirmed still true on applereview account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter64 public share-link feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend routes: POST /api/team/share (auth+team_access, idempotent), DELETE /api/team/share/{id}, GET /api/public/share/{token}/data, POST /api/public/share/{token}/submit, GET /api/public/s/{token} (HTMLResponse). Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — the review request mentioned EXPO_BACKEND_URL but the actual env key + code uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, which is correct for Expo public runtime access. Regression suite in /app/backend/tests/test_iter64_share_links.py.
